description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to a data model client, including a notifier and a factory method for creating and destroying client instances. It also includes external dependencies like dmQueryResult, dmProviderOperation, and rtLog.

classes.name: dmProviderProxy
classes.description: A placeholder class for provider proxy functionality.

classes.name: dmClientNotifier
classes.description: An abstract base class defining callback methods for query results and errors.

classes.name: dmClient
classes.description: An abstract interface for executing data model queries, with factory methods for creation and destruction.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving a query result, for non-list or individual list items.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Callback invoked when an error occurs during query processing.

methods.name: runQuery
methods.description: Executes a data model query with specified operation, parameters, and notifier callback.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a dmClient object.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Static method to delete a dmClient instance.
